# Canvas Game Idea: Meteor Dodge

A top‑down endless game where the player controls a spaceship on an HTML canvas, dodging incoming meteors that spawn from the edges. The ship can rotate and thrust in any direction. The background scrolls to simulate movement. The game ends (lose) when the ship collides with a meteor or runs out of fuel.

**Core Mechanics**
- Rotate ship with left/right arrows, thrust with up arrow.
- Meteors spawn randomly with increasing speed.
- Fuel depletes over time; collect floating fuel canisters to extend play.
- Score is time survived.

**Lose Condition**
- Collision with any meteor.
- Fuel reaches zero.

The game can be built with plain JavaScript, using `requestAnimationFrame` for the canvas loop.

1: // Game based on IDEA.md – Meteor Dodge
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: // ----- Audio -----
4: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
5: function playTone(freq, duration) {
6:   if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
7:   const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
8:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
9:   osc.frequency.value = freq;
10:   osc.type = 'sine';
11:   osc.connect(gain);
12:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
13:   const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
14:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
15:   gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.1, now + 0.01);
16:   gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + duration);
17:   osc.start(now);
18:   osc.stop(now + duration);
19: }
20: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
21: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
22: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
23: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
24: // ----- Starfield -----
25: const stars = [];
26: function initStars(count = 200) {
27:   for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
28:     stars.push({
29:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
30:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
31:       vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2,
32:       vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2,
33:     });
34:   }
35: }
36: initStars();
37: 
38: // ----- Player -----
39: const ship = {
40:   x: canvas.width / 2,
41:   y: canvas.height / 2,
42:   r: 12,
43:   angle: 0,
44:   vx: 0,
45:   vy: 0,
46:   thrust: 0.1,
47:   rotSpeed: 0.08,
48:   fuel: 100,
49: };
50: 
51: // ----- Input -----
52: const keys = {};
53: window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
54:   keys[e.key] = true;
55:   if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') playTone(400, 0.05);
56: });
57: window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
58: 
59: // ----- Meteors -----
60: const meteors = [];
61: function spawnMeteor() {
62:   const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
63:   let x, y, vx, vy;
64:   const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 1.5 + meteors.length * 0.02;
65:   if (edge === 0) { // top
66:     x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = -20; vx = (canvas.width/2 - x) * 0.001; vy = speed;
67:   } else if (edge === 1) { // bottom
68:     x = Math.random() * canvas.width; y = canvas.height + 20; vx = (canvas.width/2 - x) * 0.001; vy = -speed;
69:   } else if (edge === 2) { // left
70:     x = -20; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; vx = speed; vy = (canvas.height/2 - y) * 0.001;
71:   } else { // right
72:     x = canvas.width + 20; y = Math.random() * canvas.height; vx = -speed; vy = (canvas.height/2 - y) * 0.001;
73:   }
74:   meteors.push({x, y, vx, vy, r: 15 + Math.random()*10});
75: }
76: let meteorTimer = 0;
77: 
78: // ----- Fuel Canisters -----
79: const fuels = [];
80: function spawnFuel() {
81:   const x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
82:   const y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
83:   fuels.push({x, y, r: 8});
84: }
85: let fuelTimer = 0;
86: 
87: function update(dt) {
88:   // Controls
89:   if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= ship.rotSpeed;
90:   if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += ship.rotSpeed;
91:   if (keys.ArrowUp && ship.fuel > 0) {
92:     ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
93:     ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
94:     ship.fuel -= 0.05;
95:   }
96:   // Move ship
97:   ship.x += ship.vx; ship.y += ship.vy;
98:   // Simple friction
99:   ship.vx *= 0.99; ship.vy *= 0.99;
100:   // Keep inside canvas (wrap)
101:   if (ship.x < 0) ship.x = canvas.width;
102:   if (ship.x > canvas.width) ship.x = 0;
103:   if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = canvas.height;
104:   if (ship.y > canvas.height) ship.y = 0;
105: 
106:   // Meteors
107:   meteorTimer += dt;
108:   if (meteorTimer > 1000) { spawnMeteor(); meteorTimer = 0; }
109:   meteors.forEach(m => { m.x += m.vx; m.y += m.vy; });
110:   // Remove off‑screen meteors
111:   for (let i = meteors.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
112:     const m = meteors[i];
113:     if (m.x < -50 || m.x > canvas.width+50 || m.y < -50 || m.y > canvas.height+50) meteors.splice(i,1);
114:   }
115: 
116:   // Fuel canisters
117:   fuelTimer += dt;
118:   if (fuelTimer > 5000) { spawnFuel(); fuelTimer = 0; }
119:   // Collision ship‑fuel
120:   for (let i = fuels.length-1; i>=0; i--) {
121:     const f = fuels[i];
122:     const d = Math.hypot(ship.x-f.x, ship.y-f.y);
123:     if (d < ship.r + f.r) { ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 30); fuels.splice(i,1); playTone(600,0.05); }
124:   }
125: 
126:   // Collision ship‑meteor
127:   for (const m of meteors) {
128:     const d = Math.hypot(ship.x-m.x, ship.y-m.y);
129:     if (d < ship.r + m.r) { gameOver(); return; }
130:   }
131: }
132: 
133: let score = 0;
134: let lastTime = performance.now();
135: let running = true;
136: function gameOver() {
137:   playTone(100, 0.3); // low crash tone
138:   running = false;
139:   alert(`Game Over! Score: ${Math.floor(score)}s`);
140: }
141: 
142: // ----- Graphics -----
143: function drawBackground() {
144:   // starfield background
145:   ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
146:   ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
147:   ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
148:   for (let i=0;i<stars.length;i++){
149:     const s=stars[i];
150:     ctx.fillRect(s.x,s.y,1,1);
151:     s.x+=s.vx; s.y+=s.vy;
152:     if(s.x<0||s.x>canvas.width||s.y<0||s.y>canvas.height){s.x=Math.random()*canvas.width; s.y=Math.random()*canvas.height;}
153:   }
154: }
155: 
156: function drawShip(){
157:   ctx.save();
158:   ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
159:   ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
160:   // ship body gradient
161:   const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(ship.r,0,-ship.r,0);
162:   grad.addColorStop(0,'#0f0');
163:   grad.addColorStop(1,'#004400');
164:   ctx.fillStyle=grad;
165:   ctx.beginPath();
166:   ctx.moveTo(ship.r,0);
167:   ctx.lineTo(-ship.r/2, ship.r/2);
168:   ctx.lineTo(-ship.r/2, -ship.r/2);
169:   ctx.closePath();
170:   ctx.fill();
171:   // thrust flame when accelerating
172:   if(keys.ArrowUp && ship.fuel>0){
173:     ctx.fillStyle='orange';
174:     ctx.beginPath();
175:     ctx.moveTo(-ship.r/2,0);
176:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r-8, ship.r/3);
177:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r-8, -ship.r/3);
178:     ctx.closePath();
179:     ctx.fill();
180:   }
181:   ctx.restore();
182: }
183: 
184: function drawMeteor(m){
185:   const grad=ctx.createRadialGradient(m.x,m.y,0,m.x,m.y,m.r);
186:   grad.addColorStop(0,'#aaa');
187:   grad.addColorStop(1,'#333');
188:   ctx.fillStyle=grad;
189:   ctx.beginPath();
190:   ctx.arc(m.x,m.y,m.r,0,Math.PI*2);
191:   ctx.fill();
192: }
193: 
194: function drawFuel(f){
195:   const grad=ctx.createRadialGradient(f.x,f.y,0,f.x,f.y,f.r);
196:   grad.addColorStop(0,'#ff0');
197:   grad.addColorStop(1,'#aa6600');
198:   ctx.fillStyle=grad;
199:   ctx.beginPath();
200:   ctx.arc(f.x,f.y,f.r,0,Math.PI*2);
201:   ctx.fill();
202: }
203: 
204: function drawHUD(){
205:   ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
206:   ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
207:   ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 20);
208:   ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score)}s`, 10, 40);
209: }
210: 
211: function draw(){
212:   drawBackground();
213:   drawShip();
214:   ctx.fillStyle = '#888'; // fallback for any remaining meteors if gradient fails
215:   for (const m of meteors) { drawMeteor(m); }
216:   for (const f of fuels) { drawFuel(f); }
217:   drawHUD();
218: }

257: }

259: function loop(now) {
260:   const dt = now - lastTime;
261:   lastTime = now;
262:   if (running) {
